notes.title: Patch 10.2 - Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed: Loading save where you stand in boat still teleports the boat elsewhere on load, making you fall through.
Fixed: Player can fall thru map before map streaming finishes after loading a save
Added Prototype: Entitry 'The Hole'

notes.title: 0.10 Patch 1
notes.content:
- Changed rendering backend to Forward+ and GPU Resident Drawer for testing. Temporarily fixes Terrain Shading problems
- Improved Sun appearance, rotated orbit axis for more northern appearance
- Fog, FX tweaks and Vegetation shading tweaks
- Fix GI blending

notes.title: December Update 0.10
notes.content:
- Added swimming
- Ship is now using simulated buoyancy
- Player now moves with physics objects while standing on them
- Added numerous ambient signals for SDR
- Added secret "StoryProgression" mechanic
- Minor terrain updates
- Added new email event
- Migrated to a completely new water rendering/sim solution
- Major Rendering backend changes which should improve performance

- Fixed game crash while going to sleep on 3rd day
